verdict.rationale: Omarchy documents an official `omarchy` CLI for controlling the system (also pitched for AI agents doing customization), plus scriptable commands like `omarchy-snapshot create` and bundled agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code) with skills. Together these offer a scriptable surface and agent-driven help, but nothing is presented as a dedicated tool for automating repetitive tasks. Missing for 10: a dedicated built-in automation/macro/task-scheduling tool, documentation of scripting workflows for repetitive tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration of automation use.
